name: electrochem
title: Electrochemistry
description: Cyclic voltammetry peaks (Epa, Epc, ΔEp, E1/2, ipa/ipc), Tafel slopes and exchange current densities, and equivalent-circuit fits of impedance spectra (R(RC), R(RQ), Randles, or any circuit written as R0-p(R1,CPE1)-W1) with a Nyquist graph template. Potentials in V, impedances in Ω, frequencies in Hz.

actions.name: cv_peaks
actions.title: CV Peaks
actions.description: Oxidation and reduction peaks of one cycle of a cyclic voltammogram: Epa, Epc, ΔEp = Epa − Epc, E1/2 = (Epa + Epc)/2 (V), the peak currents ipa and ipc as heights above an optional linear baseline, and ipa/ipc. Makes peak_E and peak_i (the two peaks, to plot over the CV) and, with a baseline, baseline (to plot against the potential).

potential.title: Potential
potential.description: The potential of each point (V, or mV when that is the wave's unit).

cycle.title: Cycle
cycle.description: Which positive-going and negative-going sweep to use: 1 for the first of each.

window.title: Peak window (V)
window.description: Look for the peaks only between these two potentials.

anodic_baseline.title: Anodic baseline (V)
anodic_baseline.description: A potential range of the positive-going sweep before the oxidation peak; a line fitted there is the baseline of ipa.

cathodic_baseline.title: Cathodic baseline (V)
cathodic_baseline.description: A potential range of the negative-going sweep before the reduction peak; a line fitted there is the baseline of ipc.

convention.title: Current sign
convention.description: anodic positive (IUPAC): oxidation currents are positive.

actions.name: tafel
actions.title: Tafel Slope
actions.description: Fits log10|j| = log10 j0 + (E − E_eq)/b over a potential range: the Tafel slope b (mV/dec, negative on the cathodic branch), the exchange current density j0 (extrapolated to E_eq) and the transfer coefficient α, with uncertainties from the fit. Makes abs (|j|) and fit (the line from E_eq to the end of the range), to plot against the potential on a log axis.

e_eq.title: Equilibrium potential (V)
e_eq.description: Where η = 0: 0 when the potential wave is already an overpotential.

area.title: Electrode area
area.description: The current is divided by it: in cm², j0 is per cm².

actions.name: eis_fit
actions.title: EIS Fit
actions.description: Fits an equivalent circuit to an impedance spectrum by complex nonlinear least squares: R(RC) = R0 + R1∥C1, R(RQ) = R0 + R1∥CPE, or Randles = R0 + CPE∥(R1 + Warburg σ). Reports the parameters with their uncertainties and χ², and makes zre_fit and zim_fit at the measured frequencies, for a Nyquist plot over the data.

imaginary.title: Imaginary wave holds
imaginary.description: -Z'': positive for a capacitive arc, as Nyquist plots show it.

weighting.title: Weighting
weighting.description: modulus divides each point's residuals by |Z|.

actions.name: eis_circuit
actions.title: EIS Circuit Fit
actions.description: Fits any equivalent circuit written as text, as impedance.py writes them: elements in series joined by -, in parallel as p(…, …), each a kind and a label starting with a digit or _. Kinds: R (Ω), C (F), L (H), CPE or Q (Q, n), W (semi-infinite Warburg σ), Wo and Ws (finite Warburg, open and short: Z0, τ). R0-p(R1,CPE1)-W1, say, or R0-p(R1,CPE1)-p(R2,CPE2) for two arcs. Starts from a guess made from the spectrum's shape (or the starting values given) and from starts scattered around it, and keeps the best fit. Reports each parameter with its uncertainty and χ², and makes zre_fit and zim_fit at the measured frequencies.

circuit.title: Circuit
circuit.description: R0-p(R1,CPE1)-W1, say: - for series, p(a, b) for parallel. Parameters are named after their elements: R1, C1, Q1 and n1 for CPE1, W1, Wo1_Z0 and Wo1_tau.

guess.title: Starting values
guess.description: One number per parameter, in the order the circuit names them (R0, R1, Q1, n1 for R0-p(R1,CPE1)). Left empty, they are guessed from the spectrum.

imaginary.title: Imaginary wave holds
imaginary.description: -Z'': positive for a capacitive arc, as Nyquist plots show it.

weighting.title: Weighting
weighting.description: modulus divides each point's residuals by |Z|.

editors.name: eis
editors.title: EIS Circuit Fitting
editors.description: An equivalent circuit written as text, its parameters in a table, and Nyquist and Bode plots of the spectrum and the circuit, drawn again at each edit and fitted with eis_circuit.
